mapper.select: SELECT FROM question q JOIN chapter c ON c.id=q.chapter_id WHERE q.id=#{id}

SELECT FROM question q JOIN chapter c ON c.id=q.chapter_id WHERE c.course_id=#{courseId} AND c.is_current=1 AND c.id=#{chapterId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_knowledge qk WHERE qk.question_id=q.id AND qk.knowledge_id=#{knowledgeId}) ORDER BY q.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM practice_item i JOIN practice p ON p.id=i.practice_id WHERE p.student_id=#{studentId} AND p.status='SUBMITTED' AND p.archived=0 AND i.question_id=#{questionId} AND i.is_correct=0
